name: Heidi Tripp
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: Pennsylvania State University The Dickinson School of Law
about: As a senior associate attorney at Angela Campbell Law, LLC, in Denver, Colorado, Heidi Tripp stands as a steadfast defender for individuals facing criminal convictions. She passionately believes in delivering top-notch representation to every client, no matter the allegations. Her practice areas are diverse and include:

Since joining Angela Campbell Law, LLC, in 2025, Ms. Tripp has been a relentless champion for her clients' rights, especially in appellate and post-conviction arenas. She grew up in California and Missouri, later moving to the East Coast for her legal studies. She earned her J.D. from Penn State Dickinson Law – University Park in 2020 and became licensed in Colorado the same year.

While at law school, Ms. Tripp played key roles as vice president of the Criminal Law Society, contributed to the Civil Rights Appellate Clinic, edited for the Penn State Law Review and gained hands-on experience as a student extern for the United States District Court for the Middle District of Pennsylvania.

Upon relocating to Colorado, Ms. Trip expanded her practice to offer guidance on the collateral impacts of criminal convictions, using her distinctive approach to connect deeply with her clients and their cases. She employs her adeptness in mitigation to assist clients in seeking clemency, navigating the parole process, obtaining referrals for special needs parole and resolving issues related to warrants and extradition.

Ms. Tripp’s peers commend her for fostering a practice that prioritizes client-centered service, meticulous attention and a fervent commitment to guiding clients through their legal predicaments. She boasts a "Superb" rating on Avvo.
